notes: v0.3.27 - a failed update can no longer leave you without the companion app. The last one died with "Failed to load Python DLL": the new build could not unpack itself, and because the working copy had already been overwritten there was nothing to go back to. It now keeps the old copy until the new one has proved it answers, retries the launch three times in case a virus scanner is holding a brand-new file, and restores and restarts the old one if the new one never comes up. Also: the agent now knows which of the things it remembers came from your setup interview.
